criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Summarize validated forecast results with horizon, uncertainty and source metrics; do not invent business impact.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Retrieve from approved forecasting documentation with source metadata and grounded responses.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Convert questions to schema-aware read-only SQL, reject unsafe statements and validate date filters.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Coordinate forecast/data query, retrieval and summary tools with explicit routing and traceable outputs.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Test grounding, time-period correctness, prompt injection, privacy and unsupported claims; document failure cases.
